test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

bread and butter

options.text: An activity you do with determination
An activity you do to improve your culinary skills
An activity you do to get help others
An activity you do to get money for basic needs

solution: The correct answer is **Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"bread and butter"** means an activity or job that provides the main source of income. (जीविका का साधन) • **Example:** Writing is his bread and butter; it pays all his bills. • **Activity to get money for basic needs** refers to something that one does primarily to earn money to cover essential living expenses. (मूलभूत आवश्यकताओं के लिए पैसा कमाने की गतिविधि) • **Example:** Many people find that their 9-to-5 job is their **bread and butter.** Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is:*** An activity you do to get money for basic needs.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** An activity you do with determination (दृढ़ संकल्प के साथ की गई गतिविधि) • **Example:** She pursued her studies with determination, never giving up. • **Option 2:** An activity you do to improve your culinary skills (अपने पाक कौशल को सुधारने के लिए की गई गतिविधि) • **Example:** Taking cooking classes is a great way to improve your culinary skills. • **Option 3:** An activity you do to get help others (दूसरों की मदद करने के लिए की गई गतिविधि) • **Example:** Volunteering at the shelter is an activity she does to help others. 4d:Tced, The correct answer is** Option 2)**
